**Finding submitted: INDEMN — missing (fallback cure proposed).**

- **Investigation:** Read every section (sec-p0001, sec-1.4, sec-5.4, sec-p0072) and searched for indemnify/hold harmless/defend/infringe/claim/damages/liability. The only responsive hits were the advertising-content covenant (§7.2, p0046) and the no-joint-venture agency language (p0061–p0062) — neither is an indemnity. Section 9 (Warranties) carries only mutual authority reps plus the Globix carve-out; Section 10 has no indemnity or liability limitation.
- **Classification:** Genuinely absent Vendor indemnity for a Site that HDI designs, hosts and operates — walk-away territory, so actionable.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` p0058 (end of the warranty section, immediately before General Provisions) adding new §9.1 at the **fallback** level: HDI IP indemnity for the Site/services, the three customary exclusions (Company modifications, combinations, specifications/Content), procure/modify/replace remedies with fee refund if unavailable, and a 3× annual-fees super-cap. I deliberately did not go to preferred, because the preferred checklist would require creating a new Company-side indemnity obligation that does not exist today; the rationale flags the preferred coverage as our negotiating preference instead. No defined term or cross-reference is disturbed.
